title: [Minor Visual Bug] Automation Location - Lat & Long not correctly displayed
symptom: When configuring an automation based on location, the field is not wide enough to display the number, with the default number of 6 decimal places. The first 1-2 digits of the integer value are obscured behind the [-] sign, and the last 1-2 digits of the decimal value are obscured behind the [+] sign.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit referenced in the thread: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/062324f6e14c934d4b11b1d46c7a1e3b6621ebe8
